description: Enriched drop-in for DbtProjectComponent — real freshness policies (models + sources), exposure/mesh AssetSpecs, contract asset checks, per-model partitions/automation from dbt meta, and rich docs metadata. All opt-in; defaults preserve base DbtProjectComponent behavior.

project.label: Project
project.description: Path to the dbt project directory (containing dbt_project.yml).

translation.label: Translation
translation.description: Optional per-node translation config (owners, groups, tags, kinds, etc).

dbt_docs_url.label: dbt Docs URL
dbt_docs_url.description: Base URL of your hosted dbt docs site. Each asset gets a clickable {dbt_docs_url}/#!/{resource_type}/{unique_id} link.

include_exposures.label: Include Exposures (metadata)
include_exposures.description: Attach downstream-exposure list as JSON metadata on each model asset. See emit_exposures_as_assets for the AssetSpec form.

include_metrics.label: Include Metrics
include_metrics.description: Attach dbt metric definitions as JSON metadata on each referenced model.

include_semantic_models.label: Include Semantic Models
include_semantic_models.description: Attach dbt semantic-model definitions as JSON metadata on each referenced model.

include_contracts.label: Include Contracts (metadata)
include_contracts.description: Attach contract-enforced flag + column constraints as metadata. See emit_contract_checks for AssetCheckSpec form.

include_meta.label: Include Full Meta
include_meta.description: Attach the full node.meta dict (minus the dagster subkey) as JSON metadata.

include_source_freshness.label: Include Source Freshness (metadata)
include_source_freshness.description: Attach source freshness thresholds + loaded_at_field + loader as metadata. See derive_freshness_policies for real FreshnessPolicy attachment.

include_doc_blocks.label: Include Doc Blocks
include_doc_blocks.description: Resolve {{ doc() }} references and embed the block contents as metadata.

manifest_path.label: Manifest Path Override
manifest_path.description: Override the path to manifest.json. Defaults to {project}/target/manifest.json.

asset_overrides.label: Asset Overrides
asset_overrides.description: Per-asset overrides keyed by the emitted asset key. Today supports {depends_on: [upstream_key, ...]} to inject deps.

emit_exposures_as_assets.label: Emit Exposures as AssetSpecs
emit_exposures_as_assets.description: Emit each dbt exposure as an observable AssetSpec with real deps on its upstream models. Adds downstream lineage — 'if this model breaks, which dashboards are affected?'

derive_freshness_policies.label: Derive Freshness Policies
derive_freshness_policies.description: Auto-attach a real FreshnessPolicy to sources (from sources.freshness) and models with dbt 1.9+ config.freshness.build_after. Also honors meta.dagster.freshness_policy (time_window or cron shape).

emit_contract_checks.label: Emit Contract Asset Checks
emit_contract_checks.description: For models with config.contract.enforced=true, emit per-column AssetCheckSpecs so contract violations show as failing checks. Complements include_contracts (metadata only).

external_packages.label: External Packages (dbt mesh)
external_packages.description: dbt package names to emit as observable stub AssetSpecs. Pair with exclude: 'package:X' so this project's dbt run skips them. Downstream lineage still renders even though the upstream is owned by another Dagster code location.

dbt_cloud_workspace.label: dbt Cloud Workspace (NOT YET WIRED)
dbt_cloud_workspace.description: Switches to Cloud mode. Currently raises NotImplementedError — the mid-run monitor + selection DSL from dbt-cloud-mesh-demo are being ported in a follow-up commit. For now use the base DbtCloudComponent directly.

job_filter.label: Job Filter (Cloud)
job_filter.description: dbt-style selection DSL for filtering which Cloud jobs to mirror. Cloud mode only.

monitor_runs.label: Monitor Runs (Cloud)
monitor_runs.description: Enable mid-run per-model monitoring — parses dbt Cloud debug logs during execution to emit per-model events as they happen. Cloud mode only.

fail_fast.label: Fail Fast (Cloud)
fail_fast.description: When monitor_runs is true, cancel the dbt Cloud run on first model failure and fail the Dagster run immediately.

poll_interval.label: Poll Interval Seconds (Cloud)
poll_interval.description: Seconds between debug-log polls when monitor_runs is enabled. Default 5.

name: Enriched dbt Project
